_doc: ⚑ S189 — TIDY (2026), the Switch-like console on Maya's bed (PLAN_PHASE4_GAMES). ⚑ REDESIGNED on his notes (2026-09-28): 'the TIDY doesn't make sense to claim directly about LGB Alliance, it is a game that the logic is supposed to teach you about the Trans away' — and the law for every game: 'a rhetoric of failure, that unables you to win, aka the queer side always wins'. So the game speaks ONLY in the seller's invented voice (Second Thoughts, 2026's own agent — its taglines are already the browser's: 'A calm place to think again', 'For people having second thoughts', 'people who went back'), and teaches its logic by what it asks you to do: tidy your room back to who you were before; her things — the binder, the flag pin, the letter with her name, her prescription — have no place; the only offer is the box, LET GO. And the box will not hold them: whatever goes in climbs back out onto the floor. The room cannot be tidied; the game admits it. Named campaigns and their words stay on the dossier (e4_offers#2), never on this screen.
